# Skawsh

> Skawsh provides laundry and dry cleaning near you in Hyderabad — pickup, wash, dry clean, and delivery from trusted local studios. Orders are placed through the Skawsh mobile app (iOS & Android).

## Service areas (Hyderabad)

Shekpet, Manikonda, TNGO Colony, Raidurg, Gachibowli, Wipro Circle, Kothaguda.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Skawsh laundry & dry cleaning services, how it works, and service areas.
- [For Customers](/customer): Download the Skawsh app to schedule laundry and dry cleaning pickup & delivery.
- [For Businesses](/business): Partner with Skawsh as a laundry studio.
- [Support](/support): FAQs and contact details for help with orders, payments, and service quality.
- [Download](/download): Smart redirect to the App Store or Google Play.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How Skawsh collects and protects user data.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms-conditions): Terms governing use of Skawsh services.
